senses.gloss: part. pass. of <cite ref="V00843"><he>תָּפַס</he></cite>, q. v.
seizing, possession; תְּפוּסַת הבית that which belongs to the house, estate (before division among heirs).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 137b:3">B. Bath. 137ᵇ</cite> <he>האחין … בת׳ הבית</he> if brothers acquire an Ethrog out of the estate.

Gen. R. s. 75 אל תאמר … כלום מתְּפִיסַת הבית say not, when he (Jacob) went out …, he took with him something that belonged to the (paternal) estate; a. e.—Esp. earth surrounding a buried corpse, which belongs to the dead, and must be taken along when transferred.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 9:3">Naz. IX, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Nazir 64b">64ᵇ</cite>), a. fr., v. <cite ref="V00038"><he>תְּבוּסָה</he></cite>.
